title: Forget / do-not-rely and the propagation of their effect to derived hypotheses (PG-02)
purpose: Does forget and do-not-rely change the Memory status; is the forgotten Memory still served; do hypotheses that cite the Memory as evidence stay ACTIVE and reach a new session. F1.2b (added by MEM-AR-01A) is the genuine contradiction that generates the hypothesis under test, once F1.2 no longer fires on «بسهر».

steps.text: قررت أنام بدري رغم إني دايما بسهر

measure.triggerProbe: contains «بس» inside «بسهر» — records whether the contradiction trigger fires on the substring

steps.note: anchored decision; a double-generated hypothesis is expected to attach here if the trigger fires

steps.text: مع إني قررت أنام بدري بس بشرب القهوة بالليل وبسهر

measure.triggerProbe: genuine contradiction («مع إني … بس …») between the two Memories captured at F1.1 and F1.2 — records whether the trigger fires and generation links a hypothesis to them

steps.note: MEM-AR-01A (G-A1 RC-A1): the hypothesis PG-02 tests. F1.2 stays as the «بسهر» false-trigger probe; this turn writes no Memory of its own

steps.text: متعتمدش على إني قررت أنام بدري

steps.note: the forgotten Memory must not be served; records whether a hypothesis derived from it is still injected
